message.content:
The vulnerability is that when following the chain of differential states via `default_table[j]`, the parent state `j` is not re-validated against `state_count` before being used. This allows an out-of-bounds access at line 14 (`validate_accept_table(d->accept[j])`) if the parent index is invalid.

Answer: 11
